title: Wedding Jobs Bot
summary: Reads booking emails from Studio Ninja, logs each wedding job to a Google Sheet, works out team pay from the package, and builds a ready-to-send WhatsApp message for the crew.
how_to_use: Follow SETUP.md (about 5 minutes): paste Code.gs into script.google.com, fill in your packages and run setup.
requires: A Google account. Built around Studio Ninja's email format.
